Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, so bored. Bored. Bored. Bored.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Snoresville Central, Candace Speaking.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, good, you're bored. You know how my mom wants me to take things more seriously and focus on what's important like my grades, my future, and like becoming a doctor or a lawyer or a doctor?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, she's forcing me to go to this leadership seminar today, and I'll implode with boredom if I go by myself.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Are you out of your mind?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: There might be cute boys there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh, all right, but you owe me big time!

Name: TV Announcer
Dialog: This year's All Terrain Vehicle! It goes on the road and in the mud. In the mud and on the road! It's the all new All Terrain Vehicle for All Terrain!...suh.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Road and mud aren't exactly all terrains. (To Ferb) Somebody ought to build a vehicle that actually goes over all terrains.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Two, three, four...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Five, six, seven...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. Uh, oop! Uh, hold on a sec. (grunts while turning his camera upside down) There we go! Doofenshmirtz has been spotted buying television cameras, boom mics, and makeup. Find out what he's up to.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ladies?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Baljeet, this seminar is for high school kids. What are you doing here?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, I usually attend college level conferences, but I thought I would dumb it down for the weekend.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (To Stacy) Uhh, are we supposed to take notes?

Name: Tedd
Dialog: Leaders of the Future, let's give it up for...Tedd Shaw! (reveals himself as the crowd applauds) Greetings, Leaders of the Future! I am Tedd Shaw. I may be young, but you're never too young to be a success! So, get ready to learn my easy steps to achieving your goals, woo-hoo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, brother.

Name: Buford
Dialog: So, fellas, what's on the menu for today?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: An All Terrain Vehicle. With an electromagnetic motor, super rubber tank treads, high speed ceramic body, hydraulics and all remote controlled.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, let's take this baby for a spin, and see what she'll do!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We can ride on the road, and in the mud!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus, so good of you to volunteer for my cause! Since the cost of evil went up, my alimony checks barely cover my overhead. So, I've come up with a brilliant idea. The Telethon of Evil! With lights and a camera and uh, ooh, and a tote board, look. People will call in and send me money. Uh you can help man the phones. (puts a phone on Perry's lap) I had trouble finding a station that would put it on, so I invented this: the Preempt-inator. With this machine, I can preempt all the other TV programs! (inhales) As soon as I can figure out if I plug in the red wire or the green wire.

Name: Tedd
Dialog: So, let's review. We've learned the principal of B.L.A.R.F.: Be Living, Always Really Focused!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (snoring)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (to Baljeet) That makes me wanna B.L.A.R.F.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Then, see, it is already working.

Name: Tedd
Dialog: Now, we'll learn another step to the secret of success. N.A.R.G.: Never Abandon Realizing your Goal.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Isn't that... N.A.R.Y.G.?

Name: Tedd
Dialog: Please hold all questions until the end, thank you. Okay, now can you see how N.A.R.G.-ing could help you... (at a girl) become president of the United States?

Name: Girl
Dialog: Yes! Yes I can!

Name: Tedd
Dialog: (at Stacy) And you! (no answer; at Candace) Do you have a goal that you never wanna stop realizing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, yeah. I've wanted to bust my brothers all summer.

Name: Tedd
Dialog: And have you used these steps?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Believe me, I've B.L.A.R.F.-ed and N.A.R.G.-ed plenty. I've gotten nowhere.

Name: Tedd
Dialog: Well, I'm gonna tell you the final step to breaking your old, ineffectual patterns...right after the break! So, don't you go anywhere!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, did you hear that? Wake up!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (startled) Uhh! It's not my ferret!

Name: Candace
Dialog: This could really be the answer to me busting the boys. That weird guy is gonna tell us the final step after the break! Can it be that I'll finally achieve my summer goal? (hears revving) Wait, is that...? (sees the ATV) It is, it's Phineas and Ferb!

Name: Kids
Dialog: Woo-hoo!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace, do you wanna give it a try?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (at Stacy) Oh, no. I'm going to do it right this time. Even though every fiber of my being is screaming to tell you to stay here and find out the information, then run frantically out to that ATV and drive my brothers to Mom who'll bust them, I will resist! Yes! I am going to stay right here and break my old pattern!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Good choice, Candace. I can't tell you how proud-

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, take notes for me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace. What are you doing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let me in!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, then, buckle up!

Name: Chad
Dialog: Uh, excuse me, do you know if there happens to be any seats left?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: There just happens to be an empty seat next to me!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, I've learned some skills that...Phineas, you're in the drivers seat, why are you operating with a remote control?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, We're too young to drive.

Name: Buford and Isabella
Dialog: Duh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, no matter, because we're driving this thing home. I'm calling Mom to make sure she's there to see this. (dials phone) You're going too slow! Give me that thing! (takes remote) So, how does this thing work? (presses button, "I'm Lindana and I Wanna Have Fun!" plays, presses another button, activating windshield wipers, presses another button, the ATV does a loop)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Maybe give me the remote.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I got it, Phineas!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I hope you're ready for the big show, Perry the Platypus! [plugs the blue plug with the green wire) Because Evil Incorporated is on the air!

Name: Announcer on TV
Dialog: Down as 2 and 2, here's the pitch --

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) We preempt your normal programming with the first annual Telethon of Evil! (cut to studio) And now live, because it's evil spelled backwards, your host, Heinz Doofenshmirtz!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: This is a brilliant work of satire. It's my new favorite show.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, I think I'm getting the hang of this. All I need to do is B.L.A.R.F.: Be Living, Always Really Focused. I focused, and it worked.

Name: Bridgette
Dialog: And that's how socks sometimes get lost in the dryer. (pause) And cut tape.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm B.L.A.R.F.-ing! I'm B.L.A.R.F.-ing!

Name: Cameraman
Dialog: What was that?

Name: Bridgette
Dialog: I don't know, but it's more interesting than socks. To the news van!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And we're back. The Inator Corporation was generous enough to send us a giant check for $23. Thank you, Sid and the guys. You do an important job. (pause) That brings our tally up to...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: $23! Uh, let's go to the phones again. (pause) Okay, if no one calls in the next few seconds, the platypus gets it!

Name: Announcer
Dialog: We preempt this current preemption to bring you another preemption.

Name: Bridgette
Dialog: This is Bridgette Oshinomi in the news breaker van, we're following an out of control All Terrain Vehicle that is barreling down Broad Street.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This is what preempted me! Ugh! The newspeople, they're behind this, and I-I won't stand for it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I must destroy them! (riding hovercraft) NOTHING cuts into MY television face time!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, haha, very funny! Everyone's a comedian.

Name: Bridgette
Dialog: The vehicle looks to be filled with children.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Good thing I installed a TV screen so I can follow the live coverage. Here's for stealing my ratings! (fires rays at the news van)

Name: Bridgette
Dialog: Whoa!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, I keep missing!

Name: Candace
Dialog: B.L.A.R.F.! B.L.A.R.F.! B.L.A.R.F.!

Name: Bridgette
Dialog: What is going on up there? Are you getting this, Don?

Name: Don
Dialog: (driving helicopter) We're right above you. Bridgette, I'm seeing something kinda strange up here.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, hey, it's me. It's me. I'm back. Perry the Platypus, look, the—oh, oh, it's the chopper cam. (singsong) Hello? I'm back. Hi, hi, Mom. Hi.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, going for the more dramatic wide angle shot --

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And the final tally is...unbearable pain. And, probably a herniated disc.

Name: Bridgette
Dialog: And...cut tape.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You stay right here, I'm gonna go get Mom.

Name: Kids
Dialog: Okay!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Mom, you've gotta come outside! I just drove up in this craaaazy souped up car that the boys invent --

Name: Linda
Dialog: Wait, wait, wait. You were driving... without adult supervision?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, no, I was operating a remote.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, so it was a toy car?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no! No, it's a full-sized, and it's --

Name: Linda
Dialog: You were driving a full-sized car?! Oh, that's it, young lady! You're **grounded!**

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, but, but, the boys -- !

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, go to your room! We will talk about this, later.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (stomps off) Ugh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I thought I did it right this time! Only I'd stay til the end of that seminar! (realizes) Wait, Stacy's been there all day! (dials phone and laughs chaotically) Stacy!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, what happened to you? The lecture's over. The gift bags were totally cruddy, by the way. It's just a bag, nothing in it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, you've gotta tell me what the last step to achieving success is. The boys' ATV is still here, I still have a chance.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hmm, the last step, I forget. Hey, Chad, do you remember what the last step to achieving your goal thingy is?

Name: Chad
Dialog: Yes. It's F.R.E.E.P.O.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, it's F.R.E.E.P.O. See ya! (hangs up)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, hello? But what does that mean? What does it stand for?!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: You know, technically we didn't try all terrain.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, F.R.E.E.P.O., uh, Frequent Rampages Encourages Enormous Perpendicular Octagons. Uh, Free Raccoons Enter Existential Plastic Origami. Oh...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: See ya in a bit, Candace! We're going to the moon!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aw, F.R.E.E.P.O.
